onRequestDesc: Auto-run in sandbox; ask for dangerous commands and file writes (default)
autoSafeDesc: File writes run automatically; dangerous commands and MCP tools still ask
neverDesc: Everything runs automatically without prompts; risk of data loss
readOnlyDesc: No writes or command execution; answer questions only
workspaceWriteDesc: Read/write files in the project directory and run commands (recommended)
fullAccessDesc: Edit any file and run commands; risk of data loss
hotkeyHint: 1 Deny · 2 Allow once · 3 This chat · 4 Always
reasonPlaceholder: Optional: explain why or what you expect (e.g. "use npm, not pnpm"). On denial the agent sees the reason and adjusts.
